data.body: Close assessment / AC4 verification (2026-09-08T17:14Z): the bounded-ceiling dependency has now landed and is live. Current host state: root is 16G/60G (27%); /var/gerrit is 13G/50G (25%); /var/lib/rebar/gate-scratch is mounted on its own 50G volume at 20G/50G (39%). Docker Build Cache is 2.113GB against the 5GiB builder.gc maxUsedSpace; journald is 1.8G with its cap in service; /var/tmp rebar residue list is empty; docker_storage/disk/journal/tmp/container/gate-scratch related CloudWatch alarms are all OK. The bounded-ceiling class is covered by the landed epic-6202 work: S1 gate scratch volume live, S2 Docker/BuildKit cap+alarms, S3 journald cap+alarms, S4 /var/tmp cleanup/cap+alarms, S5 writable container layer reaper/alarms, plus AC1/AC2 missing-data alarm fixes on this ticket. This is a ceiling architecture, not a one-off prune.
